title: Important Updates on Mark Price Calculation of Futures Contracts (2025-05-05)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance constantly reviews its product and service offerings to ensure the best user experience for all users. Effective from  2025-05-05 09:00 (UTC) , Binance Futures will make adjustments to mark price calculations by updating the basis of Price 2 from 2.5-minute basis to 1-minute basis, with details as follows: Futures Contracts Before the Adjustment After the Adjustment USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Perpetual Contracts Mark Price = Median (Price 1, Price 2, Contract Price) Where Price 2 = Price Index + Moving Average (2.5-Minute Basis)  Note: The Moving Average (2.5-Minute Basis) is calculated as the average of 30 data points over a 2.5-minute period.  The basis is calculated every 5 seconds by taking the average of the bid and ask prices and then subtracting the Price Index. Mark Price = Median (Price 1, Price 2, Contract Price) Where Price 2 = Price Index + Moving Average (1-Minute Basis)  Note: The Moving Average (1-Minute Basis) is calculated as the average of 60 data points over a 1-minute period. The basis is calculated every second by taking the average of the bid and ask prices and then subtracting the Price Index. USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Delivery Contracts Mark Price = Price Index + Moving Average (2.5-Minute Basis)  Note: Moving Average (2.5-Minute Basis) = Moving Average ((Bid1 + Ask1) / 2 - Price Index), calculated each second in a 2.5-minute interval.  The basis is calculated every 5 seconds by taking the average of the bid and ask prices and then subtracting the Price Index. Mark Price = Price Index + Moving Average (1-Minute Basis)  Note: Moving Average (1-Minute Basis) = Moving Average ((Bid1 + Ask1) / 2 - Price Index), calculated each second in a 1-minute interval.  The basis is calculated every second by taking the average of the bid and ask prices and then subtracting the Price Index. For More Information: What Are Mark Price and Price Index in USDⓈ-Margined Futures? Mark Price and Price Index of COIN-Margined Contracts Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-05-02 Note: This announcement was amended on 2025-05-05 to update the mark price calculations.
